DETAILS: www.stephenhawes.com

This is the first implementation of my RFID Door Unlocker system. It's very crudely attached to my door with tape, but proves that it is possible.

The system only unlocks the door when my RFID implant tag is presented to the scanner.

DETAILS: www.stephenhawes.com

The servo turns only when my RFID implant is presented to the scanner, but denies access when the RFID card is presented.
